monkey_book.text: Nice to meet you! I'm Montan.
Takes it out on things when angry
The key's so heavy, my back hurts
A big building's going up by my home
Am I hidden? Am I hidden?
Drinks loads of water through the nose
Wants to fly, but it's scary
Dreams of carrying the Olympic torch
No playing with fire, especially at night
Can't see a fire without putting it out
Whip up wind with the fan
Some nights, I danced like mad
Gets attacked by its own prey
Next to life, this slope is nothing...
Quick to fight, but a romantic
Has never once hit the target
Plans to stay young at heart
Wants to sneak into a castle someday
If I stop, that guy will get me
Wants to snipe that running guy
Ho ho ho! I'm no fool
Can only tie a plain knot
Fire a laser from the tail
Always cold, but doesn't realize it
Wants to swim in clean water for once
Hooked on tickling myself into sneezes
Has a habit of turning right
Runs up the down escalator too
Should aim a bit more to the left
This wheel has no play in it
I'd love to drown in a pool of juice
Hair-dryer air smells like my head
Gets a left leg cramp when jumping
My girlfriend won't say where she lives
Red scroll, blue scroll, yellow scroll
Wants sound effects for cool poses
Want to be big? Take risks
Spins anything when in the mood
Got a gripe? Take it out on me!
Wants to push blocks with paw pads
Doesn't notice a pat on the back
If it can break, break it
Don't stare at me like that
See a switch, hit it. Basic stuff
Too scared, so pretends not to notice
Forgetting shoes is part of the plan
Somebody deal with these chestnut burrs
Dropped keys in the toilet a few times
Scared of the guy down the hall
Can fit in even smaller boxes
Charges up by rubbing a plastic sheet
I run the wrong way on walkways too!
Wants to be called a little devil
Whistling draws all kinds of things
Some passions can't be put out
Uses lots of hearts in texts
Do you know the real sky?
To think you made it this far...
Must protect the upper core too!
The basket is full of hope
Wants to sail the far seas
Go strip the plating off your heart!
Give me the spotlight once more!
Wants to be launched... far away
My snaggletooth is my charm point
Huh? Is it that late already?
Nice guy, but can't read the room
Missed my chance to say it again
Cake and love are better sweet
